ns2:section.sectionText: New freshmen in Engineering or Engineering-rate majors must enroll in lecture EL1 or EL2. Continuing students in Engineering who register after May 25, 2017, should e-mail mathadvising@illinois.edu with name, UIN, and continuing status to receive an override.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Civil Engineering or Computer Engineering or Computer Science or Electrical Engineering or Engineering Mechanics or Industrial Engineering or Mechanical Engineering or Physics or Chemical Engineering or Statistics & Computer Science or Engineering-Undeclared or Math & Computer Science or Aerospace Engineering or Agricultural & Biological Engr or Nuclear, Plasma, Radiolgc Engr or Computer Sci & Anthropology or Systems Engineering and Design major(s).
